gift.cardTitle: Gifted setup days on a first paid subscription

section.title: Gifted setup days
section.lead: Some plans include gifted setup days on your first paid subscription: extra time to set up your academy before your paid period begins.
section.timing: They're added once your first payment is confirmed, and your paid period starts when they end, so you still get the full period you pay for.
section.amount: The number of days depends on the plan and billing cycle. Some plans and billing cycles include none; each plan above shows what it includes.
section.once: Once per customer, on your first-ever paid subscription. They aren't added to renewals, plan changes or later subscriptions.
section.trial: Separate from the free trial: starting with a free trial doesn't use them up.
